name: project-overview-dashboard-fit
goal: Keep the signed-in Hub dashboard cards, filters and document inside each supported viewport.

evidence: The compiled Hub 5154504400 phone capture projects-owner-mobile.png shows the right edge of the signed-in /projects tracker card clipped at 390px. Desktop, tablet and phone retain the full card area and an internally scrollable filter strip.

Existing account-projects owner state asserted card visibility and saved a viewport screenshot without comparing document width or card bounds. The standalone tracker-overview geometry test exercised another route. The existing owner state now requires both width and card bounds at each viewport.
